zh.title: 立法院三讀通過115年度無人載具計畫約80億元預算
zh.summary: 經濟部：無人載具計畫預算全數通過；朝119年產值破400億元邁進
body: 立法院14日三讀通過115年度中央政府總預算案，經濟部表示，今年度「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」約80億元預算全數通過，感謝立法院支持。
經濟部指出，行政院已核定該計畫，114年至119年總經費約442億元，屬6年期計畫，以「產業發展、國防自主、民主供應鏈」為3大政策目標，從市場、技術、環境及法規4大面向整合跨部會資源。
經濟部表示，中部地區已提供漢翔、雷虎、田屋、佳凌等業者研發補助，並規劃於台中建置無人機電磁相容性（EMC）及綜合檢測實驗室；交通部民航局也將於台中光華高工增設無人機測試場域。
經濟部表示，未來將持續推動無人機產業發展，朝119年產值突破400億元目標邁進，推動台灣成為「無人機民主供應鏈亞太中心」。

en.title: Taiwan legislature passes TWD ~8 billion UAV budget for FY2026
en.summary: Ministry of Economic Affairs: unmanned vehicle plan budget fully approved; targeting TWD 40 billion output by 2030
body: Taiwan's legislature passed the FY2026 central government budget on August 14. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said approximately TWD 8 billion for the Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Integrated Program was fully approved.

The ministry said the Executive Yuan approved the six-year program covering 2025 to 2030 with total funding of approximately TWD 44.2 billion, targeting three policy goals: industrial development, defence self-sufficiency, and democratic supply chains.

In central Taiwan, R&D subsidies have been provided to Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation, Ray-Tech, Ten-Wu, and Chia Ling, with plans to build UAV EMC and comprehensive testing laboratories in Taichung. The CAA will also add a UAV testing site at Taichung Guanghua Industrial High School.

The ministry said it will continue promoting the UAV industry toward the goal of exceeding TWD 40 billion in production value by 2030, positioning Taiwan as the Asia-Pacific center of the democratic UAV supply chain.

facts.claim: The US government announced on August 13 Eastern Time that it would impose tariffs on globally imported UAS and components pursuant to Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962.
facts.source_quote: 美國政府在美東時間8月13日公告，依據「1962年貿易擴張法」第232條對全球進口無人機系統（UAS）及其零組件對美國國家安全影響所進行的調查結果。
facts.source_name: 中央社 CNA — 美無人機關稅 政院:台灣稅率優勢最高達85個百分點

facts.claim: Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, and Switzerland face a 15% tariff not stacked on MFN; the UK faces 10% not stacked on MFN.
facts.source_quote: 台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國、瑞士等特定貿易夥伴的相關產品稅率皆為15%且不疊加MFN，英國相關產品稅率則為10%不疊加MFN。
facts.source_name: 中央社 CNA — 美無人機關稅 政院:台灣稅率優勢最高達85個百分點

facts.claim: For other countries, large drones over 25 kg or those with sensitive functions like thermal imaging face 100% tariff stacked on MFN; general drones not exceeding 25 kg without thermal imaging face 25% stacked on MFN.
facts.source_quote: 若為25公斤以上大型無人機、或具備如熱成像等敏感功能的無人機或其關鍵零組件，輸美是適用100%疊加MFN關稅；若重量不超過25公斤且不具備熱成像功能的一般商業或消費型無人機及零組件，輸美則適用25%疊加MFN關稅。
facts.source_name: 中央社 CNA — 美無人機關稅 政院:台灣稅率優勢最高達85個百分點

facts.claim: Taiwan's products meeting US critical component and technology source requirements have an 85 percentage point tariff advantage over other countries' 100% rate for sensitive, large, and thermal-imaging drones, and a 10 percentage point advantage for general small and medium-sized drones.
facts.source_quote: 台灣符合美方關鍵零組件及技術來源條件要求的相關輸美產品，相比其他國家的適用稅率為100%，具85個百分點的關稅差異優勢。
facts.source_name: 中央社 CNA — 美無人機關稅 政院:台灣稅率優勢最高達85個百分點

facts.claim: Non-sensitive parts take effect 180 days after signing on February 9 next year; other items take effect 21 days after signing on September 3.
facts.source_quote: 非敏感零件是自簽署後180天生效，幾就是明年2月9日生效，其餘項目則是自簽署後21天生效也就是9月3日生效。
facts.source_name: 中央社 CNA — 美無人機關稅 政院:台灣稅率優勢最高達85個百分點

facts.claim: The Ministry of Economic Affairs facilitated ITRI as the sole overseas Green UAS certification site and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre in connecting with Blue UAS certification to help manufacturers meet FCC Covered List requirements.
facts.source_quote: 經濟部已推動工研院成為美國Green UAS境外唯一認證據點，並促成金屬中心對接Blue UAS認證，協助業者符合美方認驗證要求
